title: compiled/airflow/dags.json: the DAGs a release defines (A4)
description: Frozen in phase 001. Emitted by k2gen.emit.pipeline (S16); read by the DAG factory (phase 002), by deploy's preflight (S19) and by the compiler, whose needs.dagShapeChange is true when a DAG's tasks differ from the previous release's. One DAG per product with a schedule, sorted by dagId.

status.description: The product's state: only an active product's DAG is unpaused.

pipeline.description: Its pipeline file in the release, compiled/products/<product>/pipeline.json (k2gen.model.pipeline_path).

tasks.description: The task ids in run order. resolve hands the release to the rest by XCom; the others are the run record's tasks (run-record.schema.json).
